notes.title: Progress update 7
notes.content: [p]This update adds several quality of life improvements along with other changes[/p][list][*][p]Increased the max zoom out for the map camera[/p][/*][*][p]Added scaling for building UI[/p][/*][*][p]Updated troop allocation UI to support moving units on mass[/p][/*][*][p]You can now drag and move units around in all of the army UIs[/p][/*][*][p]Villages can now be upgraded to get a medium build slot[/p][/*][*][p]Village buildings are now destroyable [/p][/*][*][p]Added more feedback to the next move position during battle deployment along with allowing units to be rotated during it[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped routing units from getting a extra move action during first route[/p][/*][*][p]Added morale debuffs; under range fire and losing in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced morale to make it easier to keep enemy units routed [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed units switching spots in auto battle[/p][/*][*][p]Added buildings Manor and War Workshop for the Medlend faction meaning Foot knights and Catapults are now recruitable[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced unit costs[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Follow and Wishlist![/p]

notes.title: Progress update 6
notes.content: [p]All Units now have a morale stat that determines how much stress they can take before routing. A battle is won or lost based on if all units in an army are routing meaning you no longer have to kill every model within a unit to win a battle.[/p][p]What determines whether unit is going to route is based off of how much health they lost along with the situation they are in such as surrounded and enemy traits such as intimidate.[/p][previewyoutube="VVqYHHslQH8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Wishlist and try the demo for Ever War now![/p]
